title: Quadraticity conjecture for matroid base polytopes
statement:
Let $\mathcal{M}$ be a matroid with basis polytope $P_B(\mathcal{M})$, and let $I_{P_B(\mathcal{M})}$ be its toric ideal.

**Matroid-base quadraticity conjecture.** The toric ideal $I_{P_B(\mathcal{M})}$ is quadratic.

This is presented as a weaker version of White's conjecture. The source does not give resolution evidence for this weaker statement, so its status is recorded as open.
source_name: Aki Mori and Hidefumi Ohsugi, “Simplex faces and quadratic toric ideals of lattice polytopes”, arXiv:2606.20430 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20430

Status: **refuted** according to the source (as of June 2026). “In , a long-standing conjecture ``the toric ideal of any matroid polytope has a quadratic Gr\"obner basis" is disproved.”
